per_row_intent_verdict_authority.note: the same digest the committed replication receipt pinned as bad_case_bank_sha256; the read re-derives the comparator's per-row verdict from the sealed PLAN arm's own official score as well and refuses on any disagreement.

comparator.role: sealed, already flown, never re-flown and not part of this campaign. It holds these 70 rows' comparator answers, and every one of them is intent-WRONG there: INTENT-UNCOVERED collapses to INTENT-WRONG in the bad-case bank's own convention. The probe therefore flies the TREATMENT ONLY and the contrast is per-row and offline.

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN construction fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim, never a generalisation claim, and it admits nothing by itself. No utterance text, transcript, gold label string, intent name as content or model output is printed or persisted: ids, counts, rates and hashes only.

interval.no_bootstrap_because: the estimand is one binomial proportion over independent rows, not a paired difference of pooled metrics

reported_beside_every_number: the flown delivery check against the offline derivation's 70
the reverse count and the statement that it is zero by construction
the stay-wrong split (byte-identical versus a different wrong intent)
the re-declared AGREE expectation and the 61-row threshold
GOLD-SELECTED ROSTER: conditional rate only, no pooled or roster-level claim, and this cell cannot see harm on already-correct rows
steps: 1. Refuse unless the sealed manifest is COMPLETE at 70 rows and its ids equal the committed roster's ids exactly (compare the id-list sha256, not a count).

2. Refuse unless the flown Perception consumption delivered the row's own gold intent boundary value id on all 70 rows -- the delivery check. The offline derivation predicts 70; anything less is an engineering defect and closes the read with no conversion number.
3. Score once over the complete manifest with the dataset's standard scorer (slurp-slu-official-train through core.scoring_batch, never sharded) and take ONE field per row: scenario_action_exact.

4. Establish the comparator's per-row intent verdict two ways and refuse on any disagreement: from the bad-case bank (plan_class INTENT-UNCOVERED implies intent-wrong, digest pinned above) and from the sealed PLAN arm's own official score for the same sample ids.

5. m = the count of rows whose probe verdict is exact and whose comparator verdict is not. r = the reverse count, which must be 0 because every comparator verdict on this roster is wrong; a non-zero r means the roster or the comparator was misread and closes the read.
6. Report P(correct | newly delivered) = m / 70 with a Wilson score CI95 and the exact Clopper-Pearson CI95 beside it. No bootstrap: the quantity is a single binomial proportion.
7. Report the companion split of the 70 - m rows that stay wrong: byte-identical answer versus a different wrong intent.

8. Re-declare the AGREE arm's expectation as m x 0.041615 pp SLU-F1 and m x 0.092615 pp intent accuracy, state whether m >= 61 (the arm's own 2.5 pp bar at n = 1,080), and state in the same paragraph that this is a CONDITIONAL rate on a gold-selected roster and not a pooled effect.
title: Cell CONV -- P(correct | newly delivered), the AGREE arm's persuasion factor, measured
